lead: A `## Next group` anchor is a line number, and the session that wrote it usually went on editing that same file.
body: The windows `bun nv orient` inlines for a stale anchor are correct-looking code from the wrong place, with nothing in the pack to say so. Trust the symbol name in the item, not the code beside it — `bun nv peek --locate <sym> ...` re-derives every anchor in one call — and resolve the next group's anchors after the last commit, not before it. See `tools/nv/cmd/orient.ts`.
